text: Figure 9.3: ProtectionHook sequence chart The sequence shows the flow of control if a protection error occurs. Depending on the return values of the ProtectionHook, either the faulty Task/ISR is forcibly terminated or the OS-Application is forcibly terminated or the system is shut down.
